## 待测试功能说明

本次变更：恢复 executionSessionId 命名（保留 conversationId 与 thinking 修复），涉及字段/参数名重命名与 JSON 序列化键变更，需编译并运行单元测试验证。

### 涉及代码文件

- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/dto/evaluation/EvaluationExecutionStatusDTO.java（字段 executionSession → executionSessionId）
- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/EvaluationExecutionService.java（generateResult/generateResultAsync/getGenerateStatus 参数名恢复为 executionSessionId，builder 调用 .executionSessionId()）
- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/AsyncEvaluationExecutor.java（generateResultAsync 参数恢复为 Long executionSessionId；executeAsync 保留 Session 参数仅取 thinking 后传 Long executionSessionId）
- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/EvaluationResultGenerateService.java（generate 参数名恢复为 executionSessionId）

### 涉及测试文件（已同步更新断言）

- platform-app/src/test/java/com/ghost616/platform/dto/evaluation/EvaluationExecutionStatusDTOTest.java（builder/getter/setter/JSON 序列化反序列化键 executionSessionId）
- platform-app/src/test/java/com/ghost616/platform/controller/EvaluationSessionControllerTest.java
- platform-app/src/test/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/AsyncEvaluationExecutorTest.java
- platform-app/src/test/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/EvaluationExecutionServiceTest.java
- platform-app/src/test/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/EvaluationResultGenerateServiceTest.java

### 需验证点

1. 编译通过：上述 main/test 文件无编译错误。
2. 单元测试全部通过：EvaluationExecutionStatusDTOTest（JSON 键为 executionSessionId）、EvaluationSessionControllerTest、AsyncEvaluationExecutorTest、EvaluationExecutionServiceTest、EvaluationResultGenerateServiceTest。
3. thinking 透传逻辑未被破坏：AsyncEvaluationExecutor.executeAsync 仍从 Session 读取 thinking 并传入 AgentMessageProxy.sendUserMessageToSession；EvaluationExecutionService.copyBenchmarkSession 仍透传 benchmarkSession.getThinking()。
